claim.adversary: ROBUST within the finite context-bound Dynamic witness, exact affected cohorts, callback/mark/role association, ordinary-actual-arm refusal, detached-input/statistics/budget/publication guards and fresh previous native/byte guards. SharedVariant payload and mixed-column claims are narrowed to the measured fixture.
claim.scope: One nonempty sorted-UInt64-key part; plain MRK3 or MRK4, BASIC or COMPACT Variant discriminators, LZ4, single-stream String and BASIC Map profiles. Explicit immutable contexts bind exact independent Dynamic sites, versions and full first-block statistics. Native fixture: 12 rows, six two-row marks plus EOF, root Dynamic(UInt8 ordinary arm) and Tuple(String, Array(Dynamic(UInt16 ordinary arm))), late String/UInt64 shared values, root NULL-only and nested empty marks.
not_claimed: Every recursively admitted descriptor, actual type, arm or serializer profile is native-qualified
Native qualification of all nine locally tested structure-version combinations; native witness uses V3 wire value 4
Declared Compact JSON/Object column or ordinary actual-arm/path callback layouts, or compressed marks
Native qualification of JSON/AggregateFunction/QBit SharedVariant scalar envelopes; the common envelope policy is unchanged and this witness tests only String/UInt64 shared payloads
Native qualification of arbitrary user-declared static-value/Dynamic interleavings; this witness combines an inserted static UInt64 key with Dynamic value columns
Arbitrary codecs/profiles, incremental append, arbitrary keys/partition metadata or Compact MV/projection composition
Replacement of separately qualified Wide/metadata MV/projections or full reader/writer parity
Stock MRK3 capture, identical compression bytes/frames or granule-only local I/O
Combined-executable/full-suite/fresh-clone qualification, large-part scale, zero allocation, RSS or <=10% speed parity
Latest upstream/all ClickHouse versions or identical source/runtime revisions
claim.evidence_policy: Curated index to executed commands and dereferenced primary/raw evidence, not substantive proof from field presence, validator success or model agreement.

boundaries.authority: Scoped local implementation and atomic commit; isolated temporary native stores only. No push, unrelated staging, original-capture mutation, history rewrite or goal-complete update.

files.fact: The first block's sample structure/statistics is frozen for Compact prefix serialization; do not infer it from final-part values.
Each column/granule gets fresh prefix(sample)/body(slice)/suffix state; callbacks own the physical schedule.
V3 wire word is 4; FLATTENED wire word 3 is Native-only. Version-specific type rosters/statistics flags remain owned by the Dynamic serializer, not nominal max_types.
Variant mode prefix and BASIC/COMPACT occurrence framing remain distinct from Dynamic structure prefixes; zero occurrences emit no discriminator body.
ATTACH invalidates system columns and writes a native-owned sidecar before loading part metadata.
Nonpatch parts invalidate _block_offset and _block_number; ATTACH consistency uses file-size checks and need not reject a same-size checksum drift.
Compact CHECK recomputes compressed-file checksums, separately from selected-column semantic decoding.

source_anchors.interpretation: Primary source and bounded native measurements agree in this scope. Source checkout and native executable are distinct revisions.

design.context_owner: CompactDynamicWriteContext has its own file, detached exact site-path map and immutable DynamicStructure owners with required full first-block statistics.
design.public_input: CompactPartColumn.dynamic_bulk(name, type, granules, dynamic_context) is distinct from the existing strict static binary_bulk path. No inferred roster, no read-context-as-write-authority.
design.logical_owner: Existing BinaryDynamicBulkPlan, DynamicStructureCodec and recursive BinaryBulkEncoder AdditionalKeysOnly encode one granule with a cumulative operation budget. Each ordinary actual arm uses the existing Compact callback-profile admission validator at the site's actual depth.
design.shared_envelope_owner: Unrostered selected values retain the common single-String SharedVariant scalar-envelope codec, including its existing JSON/AggregateFunction/recursive-QBit gates and paired decoder. This is distinct from declared Object/path callbacks and ordinary-arm validation. W268 native coverage is only String/UInt64 shared payloads.
design.encoded_column_owner: CompactDynamicEncodedColumn retains structure prefixes plus existing Variant framing. Later prefixes use canonical version-specific absent/empty statistics, not recomputed final statistics.
design.callback_owner: CompactDynamicCallbackPlan uses the context-neutral existing recursive prefix traversal; validates complete unique ordered physical callbacks and separates Dynamic structure, Variant/LC prefixes and logical bodies.
design.mixed_plan_owner: CompactPartWritePlan admits distinct immutable static and Dynamic inputs. Existing CompactEncodedColumn adds only a callback-event traversal forwarder.
design.physical_owner: Existing CompactStaticWriter remains the sole granule -> column -> callback assembler, marks/fold owner and staged writer. MRK3 records the first column callback; MRK4 records every real callback, including empty ones and every EOF pair.
unchanged: Common scalar codecs and Dynamic reader grammar
Default MRK3, LZ4, single-stream String/BASIC Map and sorted UInt64-key contract
Publication primitive, existing declaration/carrier/resource/profile refusal gates
rejected_routes: Per-mark inference silently changes ordinary rosters and physical slots
Final-part statistics are not first-block sample statistics
A structure prefix is not an eight-byte Variant/LC prefix
Nominal max_types is not the physical ordinary-roster ceiling
Shared planner admission alone does not certify a Compact actual arm
ATTACH/CHECK success is not semantic compatibility
Local clean-window/EOF traversal cannot be inferred from whole-grid preparation or zero-row SQL
